'''Chase DeVitt''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who frequented [[Tiranga's Loft]]. Arriving on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] after a misadventure with [[Drake Paulsen]], DeVitt decided to stay since he had a price on his head. An exceptional gambler, DeVitt found employment with [[Tiranga]] who used his skills to counter players who were either too lucky or had a suspicious winning streak. DeVitt's reputation brought some of the best gamblers in the galaxy to Tiranga's Loft to challenge him.<ref name="BSS" />
